name: Gemini Dollar
oneLiner: Gemini Dollar (GUSD) is Gemini Trust's NYDFS-chartered dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against cash at State Street/Western Alliance plus short U.S. T-bills.
collateral: Cash deposits at State Street and Western Alliance Bank, U.S. Treasury bills (maturities ≤3 months), and government money market funds, held in segregated accounts for the benefit of GUSD holders

applicabilityBasis.summary: GUSD is a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin issued by Gemini Trust Company with 1:1 redemption and reserve attestations.

genius.notes: GUSD is NYDFS-approved/greenlisted as a New York virtual currency stablecoin, but no GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified GENIUS approval, official application, or issuer-announced GENIUS pathway was found.

mintAuthority.summary: GUSD is issuer-minted by Gemini through a custodian-controlled contract model. The custodian address is confirmed on-chain; the custodian contract itself has no on-chain custodian (issuer-backend operated).

controls.label: GUSD custodian contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294735, ERC20Proxy storage slot 1 (custodian) = 0xb983eD57aEaA180BC7a0078DDAdf1Ea217F2e421 (unchanged from prior read at block 25166610). Custodian contract code size confirmed nonzero (contract, 11430 bytes). Custodian contract itself has no on-chain custodian (slot1=0x0) — Gemini operates it as issuer-backend. Verified source exposes requestPrint/confirmPrint mint flow.

controls.label: GUSD current implementation
controls.evidence: ERC20Proxy storage slot 1 confirmed custodian address; implementation (erc20Impl) slot confirmed at 0x6704BA24B8640BCcEE6bf2Fd276A6a1b8EdF4Ade at Ethereum block 25166610. Direct print authority is represented by the custodian control above.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294735: ERC20Proxy slot 1 custodian = 0xb983eD57aEaA180BC7a0078DDAdf1Ea217F2e421 confirmed; custodian contract has nonzero code (11430 bytes) and no on-chain custodian of its own (issuer-backend model). All on-chain addressable mint surfaces confirmed. Issuer-backend control is consistent with Gemini's custodianship model per verified source.

reserves.name: Cash deposits (State Street, Western Alliance Bank)

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GUSD is issuer-native on Ethereum, but the tracked NEAR deployment resolves to a factory.bridge.near account, indicating a bridged representation rather than Gemini-native issuance on NEAR. The weakest reviewed route is therefore external lock/mint.
